## The advice we are giving you
We recommend that you invest the £7,500 you have available on a regular monthly basis into a balanced‑growth fund using both a Stocks & Shares ISA wrapper and an unwrapped General Investment Account (GIA) – i.e. “both” wrappers as set out in the recommendation context [FF:C002:recommendation_context.recommended_wrapper]​[FF:C002:recommendation_context.investable_amount_gbp].

## Why this recommendation is suitable for you
The Aldercroft Balanced Growth Fund is a multi‑asset fund (≈60 % global equities, 40 % bonds) aiming for capital growth over a period of 5 years or more, matching your 10‑year horizon and balanced risk appetite [FS:ISA:01]​[FS:ISA:02]​[FS:GIA:01]​[FS:GIA:02].  
The fund’s risk indicator is 4 of 7, consistent with a “balanced” attitude to risk [FS:ISA:03]​[FS:GIA:03].  
Using both an ISA and a GIA lets you benefit from tax‑free growth on the ISA portion (no income tax or CGT on gains) while still being able to invest any amount beyond the ISA allowance in the GIA [FS:ISA:05]​[FS:GIA:05].  
Both wrappers have the same platform fee (0.25 % p.a.) and fund OCF (0.60 % p.a.), giving a total illustrative charge of 0.85 % p.a. [FS:ISA:04]​[FS:GIA:04].  
The minimum investment (£1,000 lump sum or £50 per month) is compatible with your intention to make regular monthly contributions [FS:ISA:07]​[FS:GIA:07].  
The fund’s recommended minimum holding period of 5 years aligns with your 10‑year goal, providing sufficient time to ride short‑term market fluctuations [FS:ISA:03]​[FS:GIA:03].

## Risks and possible disadvantages
- **Market risk:** the fund’s value can fall below the amount invested, especially in a bad market year [FS:ISA:03]​[FS:GIA:03].  
- **Currency risk:** exposure to non‑GBP holdings may cause additional volatility [FS:ISA:03]​[FS:GIA:03].  
- **No capital guarantee:** you could lose part or all of the invested capital [FS:ISA:03]​[FS:GIA:03].  
- **Liquidity:** withdrawals are processed within five business days, but the ISA is not flexible – withdrawn amounts cannot be replaced in the same tax year without using your ISA allowance [FS:ISA:06]​[FS:ISA:07].  
- **Tax implications for the GIA:** dividends and capital gains may be subject to UK tax above the personal allowances [FS:GIA:05].

## Costs and charges
- **Platform fee:** 0.25 % per annum [FS:ISA:04]​[FS:GIA:04].  
- **Fund OCF:** 0.60 % per annum [FS:ISA:04]​[FS:GIA:04].  
- **Total illustrative annual charge:** 0.85 % [FS:ISA:04]​[FS:GIA:04].  
- **Entry/exit fees:** none [FS:ISA:04]​[FS:GIA:04].  

## Ongoing review of your arrangements
Given the 10‑year investment horizon and the balanced risk profile, a periodic review (e.g., every 2‑3 years or if your personal circumstances change) is likely to be needed to ensure the investment remains appropriate [KB:COBS_9A_3:02_what_the_report_must_contain_do_paraphra].

## About this report
This suitability report is provided to you before any transaction is concluded, in a durable medium, and sets out the advice we are giving, why it is suitable, the risks, costs and the likely need for periodic review [KB:COBS_9A_3:02_what_the_report_must_contain_do_paraphra].
